Item 1(5) of M/190 applies the substitution 'wherever it appears, except as provided by these amendments' (عدا ما نصت عليه هذه التعديلات). The op is an unconditional 'wherever' replacement, which conflicts with the same decree's item-specific substitutions of الجهة المشرفة -> الهيئة in arts 4, 10, 21, 34, 35 and in the السجل definition.
